Questions

Auxiliaries

Prerequisite ideas

-   Checked vowels (need a consonant after)

    -   bat, bet, bit, book, but, bot

    -   variations

        USA – PALM in this set (lengthwise but it's not checked)

    -   THOUGHT merging with LOT but not checked

    -   

**Vowels and Consonants of English**

-   different sets for different accents

-   VR  - nurse, near, square etc

-   diphthongs / long vowels

Rule

-   All stressed vowels in English are long UNLESS

-   followed by an unvoiced consonant

-   another syllable

Thus, stressed vowels are long if

-   followed by a voiced consonant

-   nothing

One-syllable only

-   Des v Dessie / Desmond

-   I am a Dub (long)

-   I am from Dublin (short)

-   I love dub music –\> less long

No consonant afterwards

0

**Noun-verb alternations**

-   two teeth v to teethe

-   a bath v to bathe

-   a house v to house

-   a knife, to knive

-   a half a loaf of bread , to halve some loaves

-   relief - relieve
